name: look_around_nervous
text: Standing in place, nervously look far to the left with a twist of the shoulders, pause, then look far to the right with a twist of the shoulders, pause and face forward again. Feet remain planted, arms relaxed down.

review.notes_zh: 脚留原地，头和肩先向左看、回正、再向右看并回正；修正版以脊柱15度、胸30度、头35度的分层转向作为全身关键帧参考，解决首版整体转身后不回头的问题。
review.review_frame_convention: review.png uses final delivered clip frame indices, beginning at 0.
